payload.claim: JBL Live 670NC is an on-ear design, not over-ear
payload.quote: The on-ear form factor makes them highly portable, and in lab testing they exceeded their advertised endurance, lasting 54 hours and 57 minutes.

payload.claim: JBL Live 670NC is a full over-ear design with comfortable cushions
payload.quote: It is a full over-ear design, with cushions that sit around your ears rather than pressing on them, and that is a big part of why it stays comfortable well past the hour mark.

payload.claim: JBL Live 670NC measured ANC approaches 30dB around 250Hz
payload.quote: JBL Live 670NC is our Best Sound Quality pick for its energetic JBL tuning, extensive app EQ, and strong measured ANC that approaches 30dB around 250Hz.

payload.claim: Sony ULT WEAR delivers more than 25dB attenuation above 80Hz
payload.quote: In lab testing they lasted 32 hours and 35 minutes and deliver more than 25dB of attenuation above 80Hz, making them well suited for commutes and travel.

payload.claim: Sony ULT WEAR low-frequency attenuation barely reaches 15dB
payload.quote: Measured attenuation in the low frequencies where train rumble sits barely reaches 15dB, which is fine for a café but leaves a lot of carriage noise intact.

payload.claim: Sony ULT WEAR is a compact foldable over-ear with effective ANC
payload.quote: Sony ULT WEAR are our best overall pick because they combine effective ANC, long battery life, and broad connectivity in a compact, foldable over-ear package.

payload.claim: Sony ULT WEAR is bass-forward with a heavy ULT bass boost needing EQ
payload.quote: Our MDAQS assessment shows the ULT WEAR are bass-forward

payload.claim: Sony WH-1000XM5 weighs 250g
payload.quote: Bluetooth SBC, AAC, LDACBattery life 30hrsCharging USB-CTransparency mode YesBuilt-in mic and controls YesFinishes Black, Platinum Silver, Midnight Blue, Smoky PinkWeight 250g

payload.claim: Sony WH-1000XM5 comfort is up there with the best with good clamping force
payload.quote: Comfort levels are up there with the best and the Sonys deliver just the right amount of clamping force, so they feel secure without threatening to crush our ears.

payload.claim: Sony WH-1000XM5 is among class leaders for isolating train drone
payload.quote: They’re among the class leaders when it comes to isolating us from constant drones and noises within train and underground carriages.

payload.claim: Sony WH-1000XM5 launched at 380 pounds
payload.quote: the Sony WH-1000XM5 haven’t managed to escape a slight increase, coming in at £380

payload.claim: Bose QC Ultra cuts out more noise than XM5
payload.quote: We think the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones are a little more invasive and manage to cut out even more noise, but the Sonys are still very good for the money.

payload.claim: ANC works best on steady low-frequency noise like train rumble
payload.quote: It works best on steady, low-frequency noise, such as train rumble, aircraft engines, traffic and air conditioning.

payload.claim: Over-ear headphones are generally good for comfort
payload.quote: Over-ear headphones - generally good for comfort, but can sometimes be let down by bulky design

payload.claim: Soundcore Space One folds, feels lightweight, has aux cable
payload.quote: The headphones fold, feel lightweight, and include USB-C charging plus an auxiliary cable for wired listening when needed.

payload.claim: JLab JBuds Lux ANC cancels 10-20dB under 700Hz, respectable not top
payload.quote: reducing much commuting noise though not matching higher-end models, with measured 10–20dB cancellation under 700Hz

payload.claim: Sennheiser Accentum has effective everyday ANC and long battery
payload.quote: Beyond sound, it brings a well-rounded feature set that includes effective active noise cancellation for everyday environments and an impressively long battery life that easily supports extended listening sessions.

payload.claim: Soundcore Space 2 uses pressure-relieving headband and memory foam for long sessions
payload.quote: It uses a pressure-relieving headband, upgraded protein leather cushions and slow-rebound memory foam, making it suitable for long workdays, study sessions and travel.

payload.claim: Sony ULT WEAR earned SoundGuys Best ANC and Best for Comfort recognition
payload.quote: The ULT WEAR also earned Best ANC, Best Battery Life, Best Call Quality, Best Over-Ear Headphones, Best for iPhone users and Best for Comfort recognition.

payload.claim: XM5 discounts can bring them closer to a 200 pound budget
payload.quote: They launched at £380, but now that Sony has replaced them with the WH-1000XM6, discounts can bring them closer to a £200 budget if you shop around.
